title: Effect of temperature and AC field duration on the dielectric behavior of PVA/GO/FeGaInS4 nanocomposites
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,49307-49319
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06744H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zeynab Addayeva, Mustafa Muradov, Goncha Eyvazova, Namiq Niftiyev, Faik Mammadov
This study explores the dielectric behavior of polyvinyl alcohol (PVA)-based nanocomposites incorporating 2 wt% FeGaInS4 and 3 wt% graphene oxide (GO), focusing on the effects of temperature and AC electric field exposure duration.
